summary_for_children: Al-Jumu'ah means Friday. It tells us to leave trade and go to the prayer when called on Friday, then go out and seek Allah's bounty.
environment_concept: A market town where trade pauses for Friday prayer and resumes after.
architecture_and_scenery: Market stalls, a call to prayer, and a mosque courtyard.

areas.name: Market
areas.description: Busy stalls that close for prayer.

activities.description: Return to work and remember Allah.
